```{r function to download the required survey cycles for a component file }
downloadNHANES <- function(file, yrs){
  print (file)
  outdf <- data.frame(NULL)
  for (j in seq_along(file)){
    urlstring <- paste('wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/',yrs[j], '/DataFiles/',file[j],'.XPT', sep='')
    download.file(urlstring, tf <- tempfile(), mode="wb")
    tmpframe <- foreign::read.xport(tf)
    outdf <- bind_rows(outdf, tmpframe)
  }
  return(outdf)
}

```

```{r Selecting tables}
# Specify the survey cycles required, with corresponding file suffixes
yrs <- c('2017','2021')

# Demographic data
table_demo <- c('P_DEMO', 'DEMO_L')

# Examination data
table_bpxo <- c('P_BPXO', 'BPXO_L')
table_bmx <- c('P_BMX', 'BMX_L') 
table_lux <- c('P_LUX', 'LUX_L') 
table_fastqx <- c('P_FASTQX', 'FASTQX_L') 

# Laboratory Data
table_alb_cr <- c('P_ALB_CR') # there is no Albumin/creatinine ratio in 2021 cycle 
table_ucpreg <- c('P_UCPREG', 'UCPREG_L') 
table_hepa <- c('P_HEPA', 'HEPA_L')
table_hepb_s <- c('P_HEPB_S', 'HEPB_S_L') 
table_hepbd <- c('P_HEPBD') # there is no HEPBD table in 2021 cycle
table_hepc <- c('P_HEPC') # there is no HEPC table in 2021 cycle
table_tchol <- c('P_TCHOL', 'TCHOL_L') 
table_hdl <- c('P_HDL', 'HDL_L') 
table_glu <- c('P_GLU', 'GLU_L') 
table_ins <- c('P_INS', 'INS_L') 
table_ghb <- c('P_GHB', 'GHB_L') 
table_trigly <- c('P_TRIGLY') # there is no HEPC table in 2021 cycle
table_biopro <- c('P_BIOPRO') # there is no biopro in 2021 cycle

# Questionnaire Data
table_bpq <- c('P_BPQ', 'BPQ_L') 
table_heq <- c('P_HEQ', 'HEQ_L') 
table_paq <- c('P_PAQ', 'PAQ_L') 
table_diq <- c('P_DIQ', 'DIQ_L') 
table_smq <- c('P_SMQ', 'SMQ_L') 
# table_rxq_rx <- c('P_RXQ_RX', 'RXQ_RX_L') 
table_dbq <- c('P_DBQ', 'DBQ_L') 
table_alq <- c('P_ALQ', 'ALQ_L') 
table_mcq <- c('P_MCQ', 'MCQ_L') 

# Dietary data
table_dr1tot <- c('P_DR1TOT', 'DR1TOT_L')
table_dr2tot <- c('P_DR2TOT', 'DR2TOT_L')

```
**_NOTE_**: Tabelas não disponiveis para o ciclo 2021: BIOPRO (ALT, AST), TRIGLY (LDLc and Triglycerides), ALB_CR (albumin/creatinine ratio), HEPBD, HEPC.

```{r Downloading tables}
DEMO <- downloadNHANES(table_demo, yrs) # Demographic
BPX <- downloadNHANES(table_bpxo, yrs)  # Blood pressure
BMX <- downloadNHANES(table_bmx, yrs) # Body Measures
LUX <- downloadNHANES(table_lux, yrs) # Liver Ultrasound Transient Elastography
FASTQX <- downloadNHANES(table_fastqx, yrs) # Fasting questionnaire
ALB_CR <- downloadNHANES(table_alb_cr, yrs) # Albumin
UCPREG <- downloadNHANES(table_ucpreg, yrs) 
HEPA <- downloadNHANES(table_hepa, yrs)  # Hepatitis A
HEPB_S <- downloadNHANES(table_hepb_s, yrs) # Hepatitis B: Surface
HEPBD <- downloadNHANES(table_hepbd, yrs) # Hepatitis B: Core, Surface antigen, and Hepatitis D
HEPC <- downloadNHANES(table_hepc, yrs) # Hepatitis C
TCHOL <- downloadNHANES(table_tchol, yrs) # Total cholesterol
HDL <- downloadNHANES(table_hdl, yrs) # HDL
GLU <- downloadNHANES(table_glu, yrs) # Fasting glucose
INS <- downloadNHANES(table_ins, yrs) # Insulin
GHB <- downloadNHANES(table_ghb, yrs) # Glycohemoglobin
TRIGLY <- downloadNHANES(table_trigly, yrs) # TG
BPQ <- downloadNHANES(table_bpq, yrs) # Hypertension
HEQ <- downloadNHANES(table_heq, yrs) # Hepatite
PAQ <- downloadNHANES(table_paq, yrs) # Physical activity
DIQ <- downloadNHANES(table_diq, yrs) # Diabetes
SMQ <- downloadNHANES(table_smq, yrs) # Smoke
BIOPRO <- downloadNHANES(table_biopro, yrs) # Standard Biochemistry
# RXQ_RX_J <- downloadNHANES('table_rqx_rx, yrs) # Drug use
DBQ <- downloadNHANES(table_dbq, yrs) # Diet
ALQ <- downloadNHANES(table_alq, yrs) # Alcohol
MCQ <- downloadNHANES(table_mcq, yrs) # Medical Conditions - Heart diseases
DR1TOT <- downloadNHANES(table_dr1tot, yrs) # Diet
DR2TOT <- downloadNHANES(table_dr2tot, yrs) # Diet_2
```

```{r Joining tables_1}

# Keep all records in DEMO, even if that SEQN does not match to BPQ or BPX files

df_temp <- select(DEMO, 'SEQN', 'SDDSRVYR', 'RIAGENDR', 'RIDAGEYR', 'RIDRETH1', 'RIDRETH1', 'DMDEDUC2', 'RIDEXPRG', 'INDFMPIR') %>%
  left_join(., select(BPX, 'SEQN', 'BPXODI1', 'BPXODI2', 'BPXODI3',  'BPXOSY1', 'BPXOSY2', 'BPXOSY3'), by = 'SEQN') %>%
```
